name: Mailgun
tagline: Transactional email API for sending, receiving, and tracking email at scale
description: Mailgun (Sinch) is a developer-focused email delivery platform with a REST API for sending transactional and bulk email, inbound parsing/routing, templates, webhooks, suppressions, and analytics. US and EU regions are available; API access uses HTTP Basic Auth with private API keys. Free tier includes 100 emails/day; paid plans start at Basic ($15/mo for 10,000 emails/mo).

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth: username `api`, password = private API key (or domain sending key for /messages only). Keys from dashboard Account Settings → API Keys after self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 emails/day free (forever plan; ~3,000/mo); 1 custom domain, 2 API keys, 1-day log retention, ticket support
pricing.paid_plans: Basic from $15/mo (10k emails/mo); Foundation $35/mo (50k, 1-mo free trial); Scale $90/mo (100k, 1-mo free trial); Enterprise custom. Overages ~$1.10–$1.80 per 1k emails.

rate_limits: Varies by endpoint/account; response headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset; 429 on exceed. Metrics API: 500 req/10s. New accounts may face temporary hourly send caps until business verification.

example.request: curl --user 'api:YOUR_API_KEY' https://api.mailgun.net/v3/YOUR_DOMAIN_NAME/messages -F from='Mailgun Sandbox <postmaster@YOUR_DOMAIN_NAME>' -F to='recipient@example.com' -F subject='Hello' -F text='Testing Mailgun'

use_cases: send a transactional email via REST API
queue a password-reset or order-confirmation message
list or manage sending domains and DNS settings
fetch message events, bounces, or delivery logs
set up inbound email routes or webhooks for open/click events
validate an email address before adding it to a list
